title: jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile
summary: 开源iOS/macOS兼容层，让《暗黑破坏神2：狱火重生》在iPhone、iPad和Mac上原生运行，支持触控、60fps，需自带游戏文件。
description_en: Open-source iOS / macOS compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with the Reign of the Warlock expansion. Runs your own Switch copy natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac — full touch controls, 60 fps, new endgame modes. Bring your own game files. 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》术士君临 iOS / macOS 兼容层
full_text: # D2R Mobile **An open-source iOS / macOS compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with the Reign of the Warlock expansion.** It brings the Nintendo Switch release you bought, expansion included, to iPhone, iPad and Mac in full: the original game code runs natively, every control is rebuilt for touch, the frame rate holds at 60 fps, and you are in a game one second after the main menu. There is now a native macOS version as well (first version): on an Apple silicon Mac it starts on double-click and works with keyboard, mouse and gamepad. Apple TV 4K (3rd generation, A15) has a community port (developer preview) that has reached the character-selection screen only on its author's device; see the device table below. This is not a tech demo that "sort of runs". It is a mobile version polished for daily play, from your first character all the way through the endgame. Platforms: iPhone / iPad (iOS 26 and later; iOS 18 – 25 with the older-API build) · Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later; macOS 15 – 25 with the older-API build) · Apple TV 4K (3rd generation, A15; community port, developer preview) · Game version: Switch release with Reign of the Warlock, 1.0.34.0 (corresponds to PC version 3.3.94012) · English / 中文 · License: MIT · **Bring your own game files** 中文: README.zh-CN.md | 100% | 60 fps | about 1 s | about 3.8 W | |:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:| | The original gameplay, because it is the original program | Steady, with no drops once the device warms up | From the main menu into a game | Whole-device power draw at 60 fps | ## What it is, and what it is not **It is:** - The game's own aarch64 program, **executing directly on the device**, with no emulated CPU. iPhone and Switch use the same class of processor; only the handful of instructions that cannot run unchanged under Apple's kernel are rewritten, and every other byte of the program is left exactly as shipped. Every class, every Runeword, Terror Zones, bosses, drop rules and quest flow are identical to the original. - The platform services the game expects — system calls, the file system, the graphics API, audio, input — provided by a small host written for Apple platforms. The graphics API is reimplemented entirely on Apple's Metal with no emulation layer in between, and the shaders are translated offline from the game's originals. - A port built for phones, and taken all the way: a complete touch control scheme, edge-to-edge iPhone and true full-screen iPad display, controller support, a power saver mode, save sync, English and Chinese, and a whole set of endgame modes and quality-of-life features the original never had. **It is not:** - An emulator, cloud gaming, or streaming. - **A source of game content. It contains none and distributes none.** There is no game program, art, text, data table or shader in this repository; all of that is generated on your own machine from your own files (see docs/GAME_FILES.md). What the repository does carry is the interface information we recorded to make the port work — shader interface descriptions, the graphics API function table, addresses inside the program and the like — listed item by item in docs/DERIVED.md. - Online. There is no multiplayer; the game runs fully offline and needs no online account. ## Battle-tested All **44** iPhones and iPads in the closed beta — 35 devices registered for direct install (25 iPhones and 10 iPads), plus 9 TestFlight accounts with one device each — **completed Normal, Nightmare and Hell with multiple characters**, and the experience was excellent. From an iPhone 14 Pro Max with 6 GB of memory to the latest iPad Pro, not one device fell behind. | | Models | |---|---| | iPhone | 14 Pro Max, 15, 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max, 16 Plus, 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max, 17 Pro Ma …（后文省略）

full_text:
# ESP32 iPhone Agent

**Let an AI model use a real iPhone with a $7 ESP32. Just the phone and the board: no computer, no jailbreak.**

English · 简体中文

Demo video and updates: X @iamhenryyuan · YouTube demo

> [!WARNING]
> Only follow the install steps in this README. Never run commands from issues or comments (for example a "quick install" one-liner such as PowerShell `iex(irm ...)`); these are not from the maintainers.

> **New: the computer is gone.** The board is now the AirPlay receiver and the mouse, and the agent runs in an iPhone
> app on the same phone. The original version (a Mac/Linux computer running UxPlay and a Python server) is kept as
> tag `v0.1.0` and branch
> `legacy`. See docs/legacy.md.

*"Set an alarm for 8:00 AM that repeats every Monday and Tuesday, then save it"*: the agent leaves its own app,
opens Clock, types the time into the wheel, ticks the days and saves. (Photo from v0.1.0; the task is the same.)

*Left: the real phone. Right: what the agent sees through the board's AirPlay mirror. The second shot is the pointer calibration.*

## How it works

- **Eyes — AirPlay to the board.** The board opens its own Wi-Fi hotspot and appears in the phone's Screen Mirroring
list as *ESP32 Agent*. It keeps the H.264 stream (no decoding on the board) and forwards it to the app over BLE.
The phone keeps using cellular data for the model while it is on the board's hotspot.
- **Hands — USB HID.** The board is a standard USB mouse and keyboard. With AssistiveTouch on, the mouse moves an
on-screen pointer, so a click is a tap and a drag is a swipe.
- **Brain — the app.** The app decodes the stream, sends screenshots to any OpenAI-compatible vision model, and runs
a planner and an actor: tap, swipe, draw, type, press keys, go home, finish. It runs in the background while it
works; the Dynamic Island shows what it is doing.
- **Closing the loop.** The pointer is relative, so the app tracks it and re-homes it in a corner; before precise taps
it wiggles the pointer, finds it on screen and corrects the miss. After each action it waits for the screen to
settle and tells the model whether anything changed. A lost board, hotspot or mirroring link pauses the run and
resumes it from the same step.
- **Review.** Every run is kept on the phone: replay it step by step with the taps and swipes drawn on top.
Export the screenshots, actions and saved annotations from **Runs → open a run → ⋯ → Export trace** for analysis
by another agent. See Export runs for agent review for batch export, USB copying and file details.

## Hardware

| Part | Notes |
|---|---|
| **ESP32-S3 board** | Tested with a Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32S3 (plain version, 8 MB PSRAM; not Sense, not Plus). About $7. Any ESP32-S3 with native USB on its USB-C port and PSRAM should work. |
| **iPhone** | iOS 18 or later, with cellular data (the Wi-Fi is taken by the board's hotspot). USB-C models plug in directly; Lightning models need a Lightning to USB Camera Adapter. The phone powers the board. |
| **Vision model** | Any OpenAI-compatible chat API that accepts images: a cloud API or your own server. |
| **Mac with Xcode** | Only to flash the board and build the app once. Not needed at run time. |

## Quick start

### 1. Flash the board (plugged into the Mac)

Install arduino-cli, the ESP32 core 3.3.x and NimBLE-Arduino 2.5.x, then:

Always build with `flash.sh`: it applies the BLE buffer sizes in `hardware/hid_bridge/nimble_cfg.h`.

### 2. Install the app

The project is generated with XcodeGen from `ios/project.yml`
(`cd ios && xcodegen`). A free Apple ID can sign it (re-sign every 7 days). The one-tap hotspot join needs the
Hotspot Configuration capability (a paid account); without it the app shows the hotspot password to join by hand.

### 3. Set up (once, in the app)

Plug the board into the iPhone and open **ESP32 Agent**. Setup walks through four steps and checks each one itself:

full_text:
# qwen21-nsfw-pose

**Qwen-Image 2.1 本地 NSFW / 姿势出图完整配方** — 作者级提示词结构 + NSFW LoRA + 136 个 3D 姿势库 + VNCCS 人偶精确姿势控制。

基于 ComfyUI + `qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot` 底模（与 Civitai 作者同款底模），复刻并验证过 Civitai 作者样图（2026-10-12）。

- 适用：Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / OpenClaw（agent 技能）+ 人类手动使用
- 内容：可跟跑的作者案例、强制配方、姿势大胆度阶梯（L0–L3）、完整依赖与安装指南

**演示**（3D 人偶调姿势 → 一键生成 → 成品，Route ④）：

## 效果展示

### 本配方输出：同一海边场景的三级对照（L0 → L1 → L2）

| L0 · 全着装，无 LoRA（提示词即全部） | L1 · 湿身泳装 + LoRA@1.0 | L2 · 极低机位 + 湿身蹲姿 + LoRA@1.0 |
| --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |

三张图同场景递进：L0 只有提示词；L1 加 LoRA + 显式皮肤/水珠描写；L2 再加低机位与开合姿态。**LoRA 负责质感，提示词负责信息密度，机位负责大胆度。**

### NSFW 效果（⚠️ 以下图片包含裸露内容）

👇 点击上方卡片展开作者原图（含裸露内容 · 18+，再点收起）

**作者原图**（Civitai showcase，本配方复刻的目标）：

| 作者 · 淋浴（tawsLoRa） | 作者 · 按摩（tawsLoRa） | 作者 · 自拍（TheseAlpacas） |
| --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |

用 §「快速开始」的命令可复刻淋浴那张（复刻输出已验证与作者原图同场景同构图，见 `downloads/samples/phase5_meta.json` 与本文快速开始一节）。

### 3D 人偶精确姿势（Route ④，136 姿势库）

默认人物图 `references/src_standing.png`；姿势 = 骨骼旋转 JSON（MakeHuman 网格 + three.js 渲染），
换姿势且保身份。姿势库来源：HuggingFace 4 个公开仓库（`Totemistyk/General_Poses`、
`Totemistyk/Ballet_PoseStudio`、`MIUProject/VNCCS_PoseLibrary_Main`、
`MIUProject/MySuperPoseRepo`）+ 55 个手工精选，共 **136 个**。

## 快速开始（作者案例跟跑）

前置安装见 install/setup.md。装好后先跑一次自检（只读，不改动任何东西）：

它逐项检查 ComfyUI 连通性、底模/LoRA、VNCCS 节点、姿势库、浏览器后端，并给出缺失项的修复指引。
全绿后一条命令复刻作者淋浴样图（~5 分钟）：

对比对象：`downloads/samples/taws_v13_shower_author.jpg`。
完整元数据（提示词/参数/seed/完整工作流）：`downloads/samples/phase5_meta.json`。

### 硬件要求（参考）

底模为 Qwen-Image 2.1 int8 套件，模型文件合计约 16GB（diffusion 6.8GB / text encoder 8.7GB / VAE 0.6GB），LoRA 各自 ≤608MB。

- **最低**：NVIDIA 12GB 显存 + 32GB 内存——能跑，ComfyUI 会自动把部分模型卸载到内存，出图慢一些
- **推荐**：24GB 显存（3090/4090 级）+ 32–64GB 内存——模型基本常驻，体验最顺
- **8GB 显存**：建议用 GGUF 量化版（社区实测 12–16GB 显存可跑 Q4；8GB 靠 offload 会明显更慢）
- 纯 CPU 不推荐（单张图耗时过长）
- 硬盘预留 ~40GB；CPU 无特殊要求（现代 x86_64/ARM 均可）；Linux 最省事，Windows 建议 WSL2；Mac（Apple Silicon）见下方单独小节
- 路线④额外需要一个可连接的桌面浏览器（Playwright/CDP，见 `install/setup.md`）

本仓库案例图与实测数据来自统一内存设备（DGX Spark）：1024×1024、40 步约 32 秒/张，峰值增量约 7–10GB。

### macOS（Apple Silicon）

- 适用 M 系芯片（M1 及以上）；Intel Mac 不建议
- **模型选择看统一内存**：≥32GB 直接用本仓库原版 int8 套件（ComfyUI + MPS）；16–32GB 建议改用 GGUF 量化版（搭配 ComfyUI-GGUF；社区实测 Q8 更快、Q4 更省内存）
- **速度预期：分钟级/张**——社区报告：M5 Pro 48GB 跑 int8 约 144 秒/1024；M1 Max 64GB 约 7–10 分钟/张（加缓存优化节点如 Comfyui-Spectrum-Qwen2.1 可提速 2–3 倍）。对比本仓库 DGX Spark 实测 32 秒/张，仅供参考
- 已知坑：编辑模式在 MPS 上偶发 VAE 编码异常，可用 ComfyUI 的 `--cpu-vae` 绕过（ComfyUI issue #16433，已有修复讨论）；内存紧张时建议单张生成、关闭其他大内存应用
- 路线兼容：①②③ 脚本在 macOS 可直接运行（纯 Python 标准库、POSIX 兼容）；④ 需 `playwright install chromium`（macOS 版），`install/setup.md` 中的 AppArmor 提示不适用
- ⚠️ 以上 Mac 数据来自社区报告，维护者没有 Mac 硬件、未经实测；如果你在 Mac 上跑通或遇到问题，欢迎开 issue 反馈，我们会持续更新本说明

## 四条路线

| 需求 | 路线 | 命令 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 新 NSFW/性感图（文字出图） | ① T2I + NSFW LoRA（必开） | `scripts/qwen_pose_test.py --mode t2i` |
| 已有角色图换姿势（保脸/保服装） | ② Edit | `scripts/qwen_pose_test.py --mode edit` |
| 已有 3D 人偶姿势渲染图，脚本换姿势（不开浏览器） | ③ 脚本姿势迁移（人偶参考 + VNCCS LoRA） | `scripts/run_pose_transfer.py --char  --pose-ref  --out ` |
| 指定 3D 姿势库里的精确姿势 | ④ VNCCS PoseStudio | `scripts/run_vnccs_ui.py --pose  [--prompt ""]` |

路线③的人偶参考图可由路线④的运行自动保存（输出目录里的 `doll_*.png`），或任何 3D 姿态渲染图。
不要用照片/插画当姿势参考——模型会把参考人物拼进画面，或直接重画参考人物；请使用无身份特征的 3D 人偶渲染图（路线③/④）。

姿势怎么选（大胆度阶梯 L0–L3、用户要求→姿势族映射表）：见 `SKILL.md` §4，或
`scripts/run_vnccs_ui.py --list-poses` 列出全部 136 个姿势。

## 配方要点（摘要）

- `er_sde` + `beta`，CFG 2.5，50 步，1152×1728 竖版
- **NSFW LoRA 永远开**（默认 `femaledVaginus v1.3b` @ 1.0）
- 提示词必须按作者结构写满 7 要素、300–1500 字符、含 LoRA 触发词
- 弱化配方（无 LoRA/短提示词/减步数）前必须告知用户代价，不许默默减弱

完整规则与证据：`SKILL.md`。

## 目录结构

## 说明

- 本仓库原创代码与文档（`scripts/`、`workflows/`、`prompts/`、`SKILL.md`、README 等）采用 Apache License 2.0
- 第三方素材不在 Apache-2.0 覆盖范围内，权利归各自原作者：`downloads/samples/` 作者原图（Civitai 作者）、`pose_library/` 社区姿势与预览（MIUProject / Totemistyk，其中 Ballet 仓库为 MIT）、模型与 LoRA（HF `Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1`、Civitai 2986844 / 2958918 / 2988215、RunningHubAI、MIUProject 等）
- NSFW 示例图仅供配方演示；仓库为公开仓库，介意图片的先收藏后阅读

本仓库的姿势控制能力（路线③④）与 136 姿势库基于 AHEKOT（VNCCS_Utils）、Totemistyk、MIUProject 的开源工作；底模与 LoRA 来自 Qwen

full_text:
CCBaga
English · 简体中文
A native macOS, Linux and Windows toolkit for a cleaner workspace and an environment you can verify.
Claude identities · Browser fingerprints · System settings · Network Skill

Features ·
Installation ·
Updates ·
Quick start ·
Usage guide ·
Architecture ·
Development ·
Contributing

**Intended use:** CCBaga is intended solely for people residing or traveling abroad to manage their own Claude identities. Use that violates Anthropic's official terms of service is prohibited.

CCBaga brings local maintenance and environment setup into one focused desktop workflow. Inspect Claude data before removing it, rotate your companion browser's fingerprint and restart it, align system settings with a selected region, and compare real browser readings with the machine and network exit.

Two applications work together: **CCBaga-A** owns native operations; **CCBaga-B** runs an isolated Fingerprint Chromium profile. Browser measurements return to the host through a local session. Changing a setting and verifying its effect are separate steps.

## Features

Local Claude identitiesArchive the current local identity, switch to a saved identity or start with an empty workspace. Choose what stays shared and what moves with each identity.
Fingerprint & restartGenerate a fresh seed, apply the selected region's language and timezone, then restart the companion browser.
Real environment checksCompare browser and machine readings with the actual network exit. Passing measured checks produces a green page and a large checkmark.

Native system settingsApply timezone, preferred language and region settings. Open desktop controls for location and permissions; see platform-specific limits.
AI-guided network setupThree simple steps, a coding-agent selector and a copyable Skill installation prompt. Give the AI your files and connection details; it handles the commands.
Claude Code CLI toolsDetect the installation method and version. Uninstall or reinstall through native, npm/bun, Homebrew or WinGet workflows.

**One region selector. Four everyday actions.** Easy setup puts browser cache cleanup, fingerprint rotation, timezone/language reset and identity archiving on the same page. The sidebar keeps advanced controls in Network, Claude identities, Browser and Computer.

The interface supports **English and Chinese**, with shared YAML catalogs. Switching the interface language does not change the computer or browser language.

The bilingual **Usage guide** covers common actions and data boundaries. See the full guide.

## Installation

**Platforms:** macOS 12 or later on Apple Silicon; Linux x86_64 with GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1; Windows 10/11 x86_64. Intel macOS and Linux ARM64 are not supported.

Linux x86_64 packages include DEB, RPM and AppImage built on Ubuntu 22.04 (glibc 2.35), plus a separate package for current Arch/pacman systems. All include the companion browser. See Linux setup for installation and platform limits. Official versions are published exclusively by the project owner, **liseami**.

Windows x86_64 uses one NSIS setup installer containing both A and B. The installer is not Authenticode signed and may show SmartScreen; managed security policy can block it. See Windows setup for installation, toolchains and platform behaviors.

### macOS

Download the official installer from GitHub Releases. The distribution package is named `CCBaga--macos-arm64.dmg`. It contains both applications:

| Application | Installed bundle | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CCBaga-A | `CCBaga-A.app` | Identity management, system settings and environment verification |
| CCBaga-B | `CCBaga-B.app` | Companion browser with a dedicated profile |

Download **one DMG**; it contains both applications. There is no separate browser download. The installer uses the same pixel-art style as this README.
